title: SIMPLE: Simulation-Based Policy Learning and Evaluation for Humanoid Loco-manipulation
authors: Songlin Wei, Zhenhao Ni, Jie Liu, Zhenyu Zhao, Junjie Ye, Hongyi Jing, Junkai Xia, Xiawei Liu, Michael Leong, Liang Heng, Di Huang, Yue Wang

title: DFAT: A web-based toolkit for estimating demand flexibility in building-to-grid integration
authors: Michael Leong, Medha Mahanta, Clara Yin, TJ Garcia, Zach Tan, Anand K. Prakash, Doug Black, Rongxin Yin
bullets: Built a full-stack MERN application (React, Express, Node.js, MongoDB Atlas) with Material UI and Chart.js that lets facility operators and utilities estimate HVAC demand-shed potential without writing code or running building simulations

Designed a database of pre-computed regression models mapping outdoor air temperature to demand-shed intensity — derived from EnergyPlus simulations across building types, vintages, and climate zones — enabling instant estimates that previously required minutes-long server-side simulation runs

Developed an interactive benchmarking map of retail and office field sites across the U.S., letting users compare real demand response event performance (shed intensity, OAT, event metrics) across regions
